messages:
alex: Evening team — i'm swapping into oncall for the 23:00 UTC release. Leaving notes below, please read quick and react if you see anything off.

priya: handing off ✅  preflight passed, smoke tests green on canary-1. left the rollout checklist in the release doc. noticed a small CPU uptick on indexer pod during canary ramp (~15%). didn’t fail, but keep an eye.

kate: thanks @priya — can you paste the link to the checklist?

priya: sure — https://go/release/v2.14-checklist (internal) — key items: db-migration v3 -> v4, indexer shard rotate, new feature flag rollout at 10%.

alex: copying checklist to here and adding watchers: i'll be primary watcher for the release window. @jon will cover DB migration watch, @kate you’re on rollback readiness (scripts + db backups). deploy-bot will post progress. Freeze window: 22:30-00:30 UTC — no infra changes during that.

jon: got it. i'll monitor migration logs and be near pager for the window. if migration aborts, i'll trigger the rollback playbook.

kate: confirmed RB readiness. i validated the restore snapshot earlier today — < 4 min restore. rollback script is at `scripts/rollback/db_rollback_v3_v2.sh`.

alex: planned release steps (short):
1) kick canary 10% at 23:00 UTC
2) monitor 10 min metrics (error rate, tail latency, indexer cpu)
3) ramp to 50% at 23:10 if green
4) full rollout to 100% at 23:25 if green

alex: risk notes:
- indexer CPU bump may correlate with new batch size; watching for queue buildup.
- DB migration has a short write-locked window (~30s) but we've tested on staging.
- dependent service `rerank` has a config TTL change; rollback requires reverting config and a service restart.

deploy-bot: Deploy v2.14 initiated by alex at 2063456898. Canary set: service=api, shard=canary-1, traffic=10%.

deploy-bot: Canary health: checks=ok, error_rate=0.02%, avg_p95_latency=210ms. (2063456920)

kate: quick ask — if indexer CPU exceeds 75% during canary, do we abort ramp?

alex: yes — abort ramp and keep canary at 10% while we investigate. pager escalation path: page -> first oncall (me) -> db lead (jon) -> infra (kate) if not resolved in 10min.

jon: noted. i'll jump if migration shows >5% fail rate.

alex: final: I set the rollout watchers in the console (Route: /releases/v2.14, watchers: alex, jon, kate). i'll post a short summary here after full rollout. :thumbsup:

priya: lovely, thanks for the clear handoff. good luck! :rocket:

alex: thanks — starting monitoring now.
